errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the y-axis metric as 'Normalized Mutual Information (NMI)'. The axis label clearly states 'NPMI', which stands for Normalized Pointwise Mutual Information.
The datasets on the horizontal axis (20NG, IMDB, NIPS) are not listed in alphabetical order.
The description fails to mention the broken y-axis, which is a very prominent and important structural feature of the chart that affects the visual interpretation of the bar heights.
The description swaps the values for the L=2 and L=3 bars for the 20NG dataset. The chart shows the value for L=2 is 0.379 and for L=3 is 0.372.
The description reports the value for the IMDB dataset with L=2 as 0.02. The correct value shown on the chart is 0.202.
